editorial:
Imagine you are stuck in a fancy dinner party where everyone is pretending to be perfect, but underneath the surface, everything is falling apart. You get to follow a bold woman in old New York who is totally done with her moody husband and is ready to call it quits. The vibe starts off very stiff and formal, but it quickly turns into a wild ride as the night goes off the rails. It feels like a pressure cooker where all the secrets finally explode, and the result is a hilarious mess that keeps you laughing at how bad things get for these rich folks.

What really makes this work is how the acting stays grounded even when the plot gets crazy. The pacing is snappy, and the twists come out of nowhere, making the chaos feel earned. While some of the side characters feel a bit flat, the main duo is gold. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the beautiful costume details, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for the visuals alone.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a huge fight where the husband finally has a total meltdown in front of all their fancy friends. The big twist is that the wife had already moved her money and belongings out of the house days before the party. She walks out the door with a smile, leaving him screaming in a ruined room. She gets her freedom and a fresh start, while he is left with nothing but his bad attitude.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves seeing rich people lose their cool in funny ways.
